source: terrainist generate (full pipeline: intent, authoring, programs, compile-feedback rounds, emit)

records.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge.

tokens.terrain: a fortified city on a coastal rise overlooking the Aegean shore and the plain of Ilium
tokens.icons: the colossal wooden horse standing silent within the Scaean gate; monumental stone circuit walls with defensive towers; Priam's royal megaron palace citadel on the highest terrace; abandoned Greek camp and beached galleys visible on the distant shore
tokens.event_direction: the wooden horse rests inside the city gates before nightfall as the hidden soldiers prepare to emerge

records.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

tokens.terrain: two islands separated by open water, facing each other across a contested strait
tokens.event_direction: pirate warships and shoreline artillery facing across the water toward the fortified unicorn redoubts
tokens.infra: cannon_battery along the pirate island shore facing the strait; watchtower_beacons and palisade along the unicorn island bluffs
tokens.region_pirate_isle: era renaissance, wealth 0.35, decline 0.4, formality 0.2; materialTheme temperate_timber; formPacks [nautical_pirate]; prefer archetypes tavern, warehouse, watchtower, lighthouse; props galleon, cart; fortified cove harbour, careened hulls, shore batteries
tokens.region_unicorn_isle: era medieval, wealth 0.85, decline 0.05, formality 0.75; materialTheme white_quartz; formPacks [arcane_magical]; prefer archetypes church, manor, watchtower; sacred crystal glades, white stone sanctuary terraces, unicorn meadows

records.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

tokens.terrain: a modern coastal city with a wide waterfront promenade and open sea
tokens.event_direction: giant sea monsters emerge from the open water attacking the coastal promenade and harbour front
tokens.infra: barricade_line along the waterfront boulevard; emergency_cordon sealing off the damaged quays
tokens.icons: monumental colonnaded modern buildings; wide marble-lined avenues meeting the sea; breaching tentacles and leviathans crushing piers

records.prompt: A small farm town being invaded by aliens.

character.label: rural farm settlement facing alien invasion

tokens.event_direction: alien drop craft descend from the skies and land in the outlying pastures, pushing toward the town center
tokens.infra: crop_circle pressed across the south wheat field; crash_furrow from the ridge ending at a downed alien scout vessel; barricade_line across the main approach road into town
tokens.terrain: rolling farmland, cultivated fields, and pastures surrounding a clustered rural hamlet
tokens.icons: alien tripod or saucer looming over the fields, glowing mycelial/resin nodes spreading across pastures, hastily barricaded homesteads

records.prompt: A high-tech apocalyptic hideout in the massively overgrown ruins of a metropolis.

character.label: overgrown metropolis ruins with high-tech shelter

tokens.fittings: blast_door on the bunker_complex; airlock_vestibule on the laboratory
tokens.terrain: a sprawling grid of ruined skyscrapers heavily fractured and overgrown by dense jungle canopy
tokens.icons: collapsed concrete towers bound in thick vines; a concealed high-tech survivors' bunker fortified among the rubble; solar collectors and comms dishes wired into mossy ruined facades

records.prompt: An ancient forest of colossal redwoods with a small logging camp at its edge.

tokens.terrain: a massive primeval forest of colossal giant redwood trees meeting a cleared logging camp along the tree line
tokens.infra: sawpits, log skids, timber flumes, stacked timber yards, and cut-over ground at the forest edge

records.prompt: A glowing mushroom vale where a strange village has grown between the caps.

tokens.terrain: a deep enclosed vale filled with towering giant glowing mushrooms
tokens.icons: village dwellings nestled beneath and built between giant mushroom caps; elevated wooden footbridges and ladders strung between fungal stalks; glowing spores and bioluminescent lanterns lighting winding lanes

records.prompt: A walled medieval city on a hill, its castle keep above the rooftops.

tokens.terrain: a steep hill crowned with a high citadel keep overlooking tiered residential quarters below
tokens.icons: a prominent stone castle keep at the summit, a defensive circuit wall with towers and gates enclosing the slope, densely packed gabled houses along stepped lanes

records.prompt: A soot-blackened industrial town where the railway meets the canal.

tokens.infra: railway_line running parallel to the water basin; towpath along the canal edge; iron_bridge crossing the canal
